findings.summary: KYSEC 给每个文件挂 security.ksip / security.boxadm 扩展属性，security.ksip 用户态不可写回；T110 原件替换按契约拒绝（ReplacementUnavailable[UnpreservableMetadata(ExtendedAttributes)]），确认替换路径对普通文件必然不可用（默认另存副本，数据无损）
findings.evidence: python 复现：security.ksip set → EPERM；同 SELinux security.selinux 将同病
findings.direction: restore/observe 应把内核管理的 security.* 命名空间排除出可保留集合（新文件由内核自动打标）
findings.status: fixed and re-verified on the Kylin machine (2026-10-19, branch verify/kylin-v10sp1-session-20261019); landed on main via PR #44 (5b07db6): restore_xattrs now skips the kernel-managed security.* namespace; the failing test passes and the GUI replacement prompt no longer lists extended attributes as a loss (creation time only)

findings.summary: 内核 5.4 mtime 粒度为 jiffy（实测两次相距 1ms 的写具有相同 st_mtime_ns），stat→open 身份守卫对同长度快速改写存在约一个 jiffy 的盲区
findings.direction: 测试注入改写长度不同的内容或跨 jiffy 等待；产品可补内容散列比对
findings.status: fixed and re-verified on the Kylin machine; landed on main via PR #44 (5b07db6): the guard test now injects a different-length rewrite; three more same-family integration tests cross one timestamp granule (50 ms sleep) so jiffy-grained kernels detect the change

findings.summary: Linux/X11 上 shift+字母快捷键（Ctrl+Shift+E 导出 PDF、Ctrl+Shift+S 另存副本）不触发（XSendEvent 与 XTEST 两种注入均不触发；Ctrl+= 等无 shift 快捷键正常），且 GPUI 窗口不渲染菜单栏——这两个命令在 Linux GUI 不可达
findings.evidence: kylin-gui 系列截图与日志（无 file.export_pdf/file.save_copy 事件）
findings.status: partly addressed; landed on main via PR #46 (fe50e74) as a File/Edit bar with path-sheet prompts making the commands reachable without a menubar or shortcuts; the desktop shortcut hijack itself is a UKUI setting, not app-fixable

findings.summary: 段内部分字符改格式（如对段中一个字加粗）后整画布拒绝渲染：document layout: Unsupported { feature: "mixed character formatting" }，文档不可显示；撤销后恢复。T200 样式切片的整段均匀格式绘制与整画布失败语义叠加所致
findings.test: GUI 复现（joyword 启动样例，加粗一个字）；NodeId 为该段
findings.direction: style_paint 按段回退或应用层按段降级，避免整篇不可显示
findings.status: fixed upstream by da5f192 (paint mixed character formatting per run span); re-verified on this machine after the fix

findings.summary: 功能区「项目符号」按钮在 GUI 上必报「输入未完成：num」：应用侧 execute_input 的 LIST_APPLY 分支只读 num、忽略 bullet 参数（shell 层 host 有 bullet 分支但应用未走）
findings.direction: 该分支先查 bullet 再回落 num，与 joyword-shell host.rs LIST_APPLY 对齐
findings.status: fixed and re-verified on the Kylin machine; landed on main via PR #46 (fe50e74): the app-side LIST_APPLY dispatcher honours the bullet argument (mirrors the shell host); the ribbon bullet button applies a U+2022 list in the GUI

findings.summary: Ctrl+O 未保存提示「不保存」后文件打开对话框不出现（无新窗口、无诊断）；未绑定文档上 Ctrl+S 静默无反应
findings.direction: 排查 rfd/GTK/portal 在 GPUI X11 事件循环中的集成
findings.status: environment gap, fixed by installing xdg-desktop-portal + xdg-desktop-portal-gtk: GPUI dialogs go through ashpd/portal; open/save/export dialogs then worked end to end (files opened, copies saved, PDF exported and read back by poppler and pdfminer.six)

findings.summary: 曾出现一次未复现的启动样例整画布 mixed character formatting 失败（首次实例，启动+134s，无输入操作），与 kylin-4 同类签名；当日其余实例均稳定

bare run now prints "No GPU adapter found that can configure the display surface" plus the VK_ICD_FILENAMES hint and exits 1; with the SwiftShader ICD the window renders normally (kylin-gui-window-with-swiftshader-icd.png)

the bare-run window-open failure is superseded on main by 4bf14f2 ("fix(app): fall back to software Vulkan on GPU-less Linux"), which auto-detects a software ICD and re-executes without a manual env var instead of printing a hint and exiting; that auto path was verified on UOS, not re-measured on this Kylin machine

launch_requirement.window: The machine has no working Vulkan hardware driver (Cirrus VGA; system mesa-vulkan-drivers 20.0.8 exposes only intel/radeon ICDs). The window opens only with VK_ICD_FILENAMES pointing at a software ICD, e.g. VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/trae-cn-enterprise/vk_swiftshader_icd.json; first frame takes roughly 15-25 s under SwiftShader.
launch_requirement.dialogs: GPUI file dialogs additionally require xdg-desktop-portal (installed this session with the gtk backend).
launch_requirement.bare_run_before_fix: Without the env var the window-open error was printed fully redacted (<redacted>) and the process hung instead of exiting.
launch_requirement.main_auto_fallback: Since main 4bf14f2 the app auto-detects a software Vulkan ICD and re-executes itself, so the manual env var is in principle no longer required; verified on UOS only, not re-measured on this machine.
